addCourse.addAssessmentBody: Learners must pass this quiz (and submit feedback) to earn a certificate. You can also add or edit questions later from the course page.
addCourse.addAssignmentBody: If you add one, learners must submit a file and have it graded as passed to earn a certificate. You can also add or edit this later from the course page.
addCourse.buildModulesBody: Add as many modules as you like, each with its own lessons (video, PDF, PowerPoint, audio, links, assignments) and an optional quiz that gates the next module. You can keep adding and editing modules any time from the course page.
addCourse.skipForNow: Skip for now — I'll add it later
addCourse.categoryManagedHint: Categories are managed by admins — contact one if you need a new category added.

addCourse.contentTypeHint: Select one or more — combine any mix of PDF, Recording, Live, and ILT. Self-Paced Modules stands on its own.

internal_only.hint: Internal staff only — always free, no price shown

external_only.label: External Only
external_only.hint: Public paid audience only — no department targeting

addCourse.departmentsHint: Leave none selected to make this course visible to every department. Select one or more to restrict it.
addCourse.departmentsEmpty: No departments have been set up yet.
addCourse.targetGroupsHint: Optional — target specific ad-hoc groups (e.g. "Q1 New Hires") regardless of department. Adds to, rather than narrows, the department selection above.
addCourse.targetGroupsEmpty: No cohorts have been set up yet.
addCourse.priceHint: Internal (Mwasalat) learners are always free regardless of this price.
addCourse.capacityInvalid: Must be a whole number of at least 1
addCourse.capacityHint: Leave blank for unlimited seats. Once full, new learners are added to a waitlist and promoted automatically as seats open up.
addCourse.expiryDateHint: Course automatically archives after this date. Leave blank for no expiry.
addCourse.certificateValidityHint: For certifications that must be renewed — e.g. set 12 so the earned certificate expires a year after issue. Leave blank for a certificate that never expires.
addCourse.certificateValidityInvalid: Must be a whole number of at least 1
addCourse.autoRenewHint: On: the certificate is silently extended before expiry, no action needed. Off: learners must retake and pass the assessment to have it reissued.
addCourse.expectedCompletionDaysHint: Deadline starts from enrollment (or reactivation). External learners who miss it get a warning after 10 extra days, then lose access after 5 more unless they've finished.
addCourse.expectedCompletionDaysInvalid: Must be a whole number of at least 1
addCourse.isMandatoryHint: Every matching internal learner is automatically enrolled — no need for them to find it in the catalog. If someone is still incomplete past the deadline, their supervisor is notified once. Leave off for an optional course with no deadline pressure.
addCourse.prerequisiteHint: Learners must complete this course before they can enroll in this one.
addCourse.requiresApprovalHint: New enrollments wait for you (or an admin) to approve them before the learner gets access to the course content.
addCourse.enrollmentClosedHint: Stops new learners from enrolling — the course disappears from the public catalog. Existing learners keep full access, so you can safely wait for them to finish before deleting the course.

pdf.required: At least one PDF file is required
pdf.multipleHint: Select multiple files to attach several documents — e.g. a handout plus supporting materials.
pdf.durationDaysInvalid: Must be a whole number of at least 1
pdf.durationDaysHint: If set, progress builds up 1/N each day the learner opens the PDF, instead of completing on first open.

recording.linkPlaceholder: Paste a SharePoint, YouTube, or Vimeo link
recording.videoHint: MP4, WebM, or MOV, up to 100MB. Learners get a controlled player — no download, no skipping ahead.

live.meetingLinkPlaceholder: Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams link — or generate one below
live.zoomCreateFailed: Failed to create the Zoom meeting
live.setDateTimeFirstHint: Set the date & time above to generate a Zoom meeting, or paste your own link.
live.zoomReadyHint: This is the link learners see. Your host link (to start the meeting) is below — only you can see it.
live.hostLinkLabel: Host Link (you only — don't share this)

deleteModal.title: Delete this course?
deleteModal.body: This closes enrollment and permanently archives the course in 5 days. Enrolled learners keep their history and are notified now. You can cancel anytime before then. Deletion is blocked if any learner is still actively enrolled.

bulkModal.title: Bulk Import Questions
bulkModal.instructions: Paste questions separated by a blank line. Mark the correct option with a trailing <0>*</0>.
bulkModal.examplePlaceholder:
Q: What is the speed limit in residential areas?
A) 30 km/h
B) 50 km/h *
C) 80 km/h
D) 100 km/h

Q: When should you check your mirrors while driving?
A) Only when reversing
B) Every few seconds *
C) Never
D) Only at traffic lights
